introduction: New York WIC provides food and nutrition support to eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and children younger thanfive.
description: New York WIC provides food and nutrition support to eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and children younger thanfive.

sections.who: Residency, participant category and income rules apply. Eligible families can be certified regardless of immigration status.
sections.get: WIC includes supplemental foods, nutrition counseling and breastfeeding support. Existing qualifying benefits can establish income eligibility.

sections.apply:
1. Contact a WIC office

    Use state intake guidance, Wanda’s referral or the office directory.

  2. Prepare proof

    Electronic or paper copies are accepted; ask for help if records are unavailable.

  3. Complete the appointment

    Phone or in-person intake reviews eligibility and nutrition needs.
sections.after: Ask the clinic about current eWIC shopping tools and follow-up appointments.
